scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n bundle,server -c cyan,green "npx esbuild js/*.js --bundle --outdir=dist --watch" "node --watch backend/server.js"
scripts.build:public: npm run build && node -e "import('fs-extra').then(({default: fs}) => fs.emptyDir('public').then(() => Promise.all(['assets', 'css', 'dist', 'api', 'backend', 'index.html', 'dashboard.html'].map((f) => fs.copy(f, 'public/' + f, {filter: (src) => !src.includes('node_modules') && !src.endsWith('.env')})))).then(() => console.log('Build complete')));"
